findings.rootCause: The legacy page stops with a PHP fatal error after its first line: install/upgrade-v2.2.php:46 queries a `settings` table that install/database.sql does not create (PHP 8: uncaught mysqli_sql_exception, tools/runtime/phpblog/build/logs/errors.log). Before that, line 41 tries to rewrite ../config.php on a plain GET (blocked: the file is mounted read-only). The generated page prints every message. Caused by the run (an upgrade script run against a fresh install), not by the tool.

Reviewed link: index.php:85 `<div class="row <?php echo $mt3_i; ?>">`; the class is omitted, flag attribute_omitted (unresolved_read) at f036#00213. The mechanical link fails because the legacy value ("row") equals the literal class of other <div>s, which carry no flag.

Reviewed link: login.php:42 `<div class="input-group mb-3 needs-validation <?php if ($error == 1) ...?>">`; the class is omitted, flag attribute_omitted (condition_not_translatable) at the if f042#00105. The legacy value equals the literal class of the form's other <div>s (login.php 54, 118, 122, 126).
Reviewed link: core.php:1006 `  ` (footer of the shell); C2Todo unresolved_read at f033#02168. The and its ancestors up to the footer have no attribute the classifier can find them by.

unsoundDecisions.where: phpBlog core.php:652 (the shell, every public page: 35 differences) and blog.php:29 (2 differences)
unsoundDecisions.what: An if / else whose condition is not translatable: spec section 6 generates unresolvedCondition (false), so the ternary renders the else arm on every request. core.php:652 `if ($logged == 'No') { Sign In | Register } else { Profile menu }`: the logged-in Profile menu is shown to an anonymous visitor (the browser shows Sign In). blog.php:29 `if ($count <= 0) { 'There are no published posts' } else { the posts loop and its pagination }` (R-I2: the loop is the else arm): the empty list and its pagination are shown, the legacy page shows the message (the seed has no posts). Classified flag-but-wrong:unresolvedCondition (37 differences). Root cause (ii): a v1.1 spec rule (section 6: unresolvedCondition is false, also where it selects an else arm) produced a wrong result. Not fixed (rules v1.1 final): a post-freeze finding under v1.1, for the owner.
